scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts ChonkFu out/raw.mp4 --crf=18 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -c:a aac -b:a 192k out/chonk-fu.mp4
scripts.web: mkdir -p ../public/video && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/chonk-fu.mp4 -vf scale=1920:1080 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 29 -profile:v high -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -c:a aac -b:a 128k ../public/video/chonk-fu.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -ss 3 -i out/chonk-fu.mp4 -frames:v 1 -vf scale=1280:-2 -q:v 3 ../public/video/poster.jpg
